title: Tech Note: Creating Customized Dynamic Store Front Pages

historical_commentary.text: 4D Business Kit has been discontinued for many years; building a modern customized dynamic storefront would today use current web frameworks or headless commerce platforms rather than this legacy all-in-one product, making the specific implementation obsolete though the general e-commerce customization concept remains evergreen.
related_updates: 4D Business Kit has been discontinued; modern e-commerce solutions built with 4D would use current web/ORDA/REST capabilities or dedicated third-party e-commerce platforms
